title: Neem & Tulsi Face Wash
tagline: Cleanses excess oil and leaves skin feeling fresh
description: A gentle daily cleanser with neem and tulsi that lifts away excess oil, sweat and city grime without leaving skin tight. Builds into a soft lather and rinses clean.
howToUse: Wet your face. Take a coin-sized amount, massage in circles for 30 seconds, avoiding the eye area. Rinse with water. Use morning and night.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Aqua, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Azadirachta Indica (Neem) Leaf Extract, Ocimum Sanctum (Tulsi) Leaf Extract, …

faqs.q: Will it dry out my skin?
faqs.a: No. It is soap-free and pH-balanced, so it cleanses without stripping moisture. Follow with a moisturiser.

faqs.q: Can I use it twice a day?
faqs.a: Yes, morning and night is ideal for oily and combination skin.

title: Aloe Vera Soothing Gel
tagline: Soothes and hydrates for soft, supple skin
description: A light, fast-absorbing aloe gel for face, body and after-sun care. Calms the look of redness and leaves skin feeling cool and comfortable.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer on clean skin as often as needed. Can be used as a light moisturiser, after shaving, or as a soothing hair-and-scalp gel.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Aqua, Glycerin, Carbomer, …

faqs.a: No, it absorbs in under a minute and leaves no residue.

title: Turmeric Glow Day Cream
tagline: Moisturises and reduces the appearance of dullness
description: A non-greasy day cream with turmeric that moisturises for hours and helps skin look brighter and more even over time.
howToUse: Apply in the morning on clean skin. Warm a pea-sized amount between fingers and press into face and neck.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Aqua, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, …

faqs.a: No. The extract is used at a cosmetic level that does not leave a yellow cast.

title: Kumkumadi Face Oil
tagline: Nourishes for a naturally radiant look
description: A classic overnight facial oil blend. A few drops massaged in at night leave skin looking rested, soft and naturally radiant by morning.
howToUse: At night, warm 3–4 drops in your palms and press into clean, slightly damp skin. Massage upwards for a minute.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Sesamum Indicum Seed Oil, Crocus Sativus Flower Extract, …

faqs.q: Can oily skin use a face oil?
faqs.a: Yes, in small amounts at night. Start with 2 drops twice a week and build up.

title: Ubtan Face Pack
description: A traditional ubtan of gram flour, turmeric and botanicals. Mix with water, milk or curd for a weekly mask that leaves skin feeling smooth and looking fresh.
howToUse: Mix 1 tsp with water, milk or curd into a paste. Apply an even layer, avoiding the eyes. Leave for 10–15 minutes, then rinse with lukewarm water. Use once or twice a week.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Cicer Arietinum (Gram) Flour, Curcuma Longa Root Powder, Santalum Album Powder, …

faqs.q: How often should I use it?
faqs.a: Once or twice a week is plenty. Sensitive skin should start with once a week.

title: Bhringraj Hair Oil
tagline: Nourishes roots and reduces hair breakage
description: A slow-infused bhringraj oil for the weekly champi. Massaged into the scalp, it conditions the roots and lengths so hair breaks less when you comb.
howToUse: Warm slightly. Part hair and apply along the scalp, then work through the lengths. Massage for 5 minutes and leave for at least an hour, or overnight. Wash out with a mild shampoo.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Eclipta Alba (Bhringraj) Extract, Sesamum Indicum Seed Oil, …

faqs.a: Yes. Cover your pillow and wash it out in the morning with a mild shampoo.

faqs.q: How often should I oil my hair?
faqs.a: Once or twice a week suits most hair types.

title: Neem Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
tagline: Cleanses scalp and helps control visible flakes
description: A clarifying neem shampoo for flaky, itchy scalps. Cleans thoroughly without the squeaky, stripped feeling of harsh anti-dandruff formulas.
howToUse: Apply to wet hair, massage into the scalp, leave for 2 minutes, then rinse. Repeat if needed. Use 2–3 times a week.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Aqua, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Azadirachta Indica Leaf Extract, …

faqs.a: Yes, it is free of sulphates that strip colour, but always patch-test with new treatments.

title: Hibiscus Conditioner
tagline: Softens and detangles for smooth hair
description: A slip-rich conditioner with hibiscus that makes wet hair easy to comb and leaves it soft and smooth once dry.
howToUse: After shampooing, squeeze out excess water. Apply from mid-length to ends, leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Aqua, Cetearyl Alcohol, Behentrimonium Chloride, Hibiscus Rosa-Sinensis Flower Extract, …

faqs.q: Can I use it on oiled hair?
faqs.a: Yes, use it after you shampoo the oil out.

title: Cocoa & Shea Body Lotion
description: A rich but fast-sinking lotion with cocoa and shea butter. One application in the morning keeps dry skin comfortable all day.

faqs.a: It is a soft cocoa scent that fades within an hour.

title: Sandalwood Body Wash
tagline: Gentle cleansing with a calming fragrance
description: A creamy body wash with a warm sandalwood scent that cleanses without leaving skin tight or dry.
howToUse: Squeeze onto a loofah or palm, lather over wet skin and rinse.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Aqua, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Santalum Album Oil, …

faqs.q: Is it suitable for daily use?
faqs.a: Yes, it is mild enough for everyday showers.

title: Beetroot Tinted Lip Balm
tagline: Nourishes lips with a natural tint
description: A buttery balm with a sheer beetroot tint. Softens dry, chapped lips and leaves a natural flush of colour.

fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Ricinus Communis Seed Oil, Cera Alba, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter, Beta Vulgaris Root Extract, …

faqs.a: It is sheer. Build up two or three layers for more colour.

title: Aloe Neem Handmade Soap
description: A cold-process bar with aloe and neem. Lathers softly, rinses clean and leaves skin feeling comfortable rather than squeaky.
howToUse: Lather between wet palms or on a loofah, massage over the body and rinse. Store on a draining dish between uses.
fullIngredients: REPLACE WITH REAL INCI LIST: Sodium Palmate, Sodium Cocoate, Aqua, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Azadirachta Indica Leaf Extract, …

faqs.q: Can I use it on my face?
faqs.a: It is formulated for the body. For the face, use the Neem & Tulsi Face Wash.
